scripts.format: npm run format:code && npm run format:other
scripts.prebootstrap: yarn && npm run check-versions && cross-env COMPILER_OPTIONS="GATSBY_MAJOR=5" lerna run prepare --scope gatsby-core-utils
scripts.publish: echo "Use 'yarn publish-next' or 'yarn publish-release' instead of 'yarn run publish'"
scripts.publish-next: node scripts/check-publish-access && node scripts/clear-package-dir prerelease --verbose && cross-env COMPILER_OPTIONS="GATSBY_MAJOR=5" lerna publish prerelease --pre-dist-tag=next --preid=next --allow-branch=master --message="chore(release): Publish next"
scripts.publish-preminor: node scripts/check-publish-access && node scripts/clear-package-dir preminor --verbose && lerna publish preminor --pre-dist-tag=next --preid=next --force-publish --allow-branch=master --message="chore(release): Publish next pre-minor"
scripts.publish-rc: node scripts/check-publish-access && node scripts/clear-package-dir prerelease --verbose && lerna publish prerelease --pre-dist-tag=rc --preid=rc --message="chore(release): Publish rc"
scripts.publish-release: node scripts/check-publish-access && node scripts/clear-package-dir patch --verbose && lerna publish patch
